item.description: BATON ROUGE - After speculation of him leaving for the Tulane job, LSU defensive coordinator Blake Baker is staying on Lane Kiffin's staff, the head coach confirmed.Matt Zenitz with CBS Sports reported Baker was passing on multiple head coaching positions to stay. item.title: Festival of Lights held in downtown Baton Rouge
item.description: BATON ROUGE - Hundreds of people filled downtown Baton Rouge to watch performances and a tree lighting at the Festival of Lights.They watched several performances and shopped around at vendor tents in North Boulevard Town Square. At the end of the night, Mayor-President Sid Edwards joined the crowd for a countdown as the lights turned on, spreading holiday cheer.Permalink| Comments
